BlockNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to block a target agent in a duration (second)

duration.description: The duration of time of the block

FollowNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to follow a target agent in a duration (second)

duration.description: The duration of time of the follow

GoToNodeSchema.Purpose: Navigate the agent to a specific coordinate.

agent.description: Agent that is commanded to navigate to the target position

GroupTalkNodeSchema.Purpose: Orchestrates a social gathering by first navigating the agent to a focal point and then transitioning into a synchronized group conversation state.

agent.description: The local agent instance controlled by this specific behavior tree node.

participant_agents.description: The full roster of agents participating in the talk. The first agent in this list is designated as the 'initiator' or 'leader' for synchronization purposes.

group_center.description: The spatial coordinates (target) where the agents gather to form the conversation circle.

duration.description: The total time in seconds the group should remain in the ACTIVE conversation state.

IdleNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to idle for a specific amount of time.

agent.description: Agent that is commanded to idle

LieOnNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to navigate to an object and lie on it for a specific duration of time

agent.description: Agent that will lie on the object

duration.description: The duration of time the agent will lie on the object

LookAtNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to look at a target position in a duration (second)

target_look_pose.description: The target position for the agent to look at

duration.description: The duration of time of the look

QueueNodeSchema.Purpose: Commands an agent to join a queue and progress to the front.

service_duration.description: Time spent at the very front of the queue (e.g., at the counter)

front_pose.description: The head of the queue. Yaw determines the direction the line forms.

post_queue_pose.description: Where the agent goes after finishing the service.

step_distance.description: Distance between people in the queue

chaos_mode.description: If True, agent ignores strict ordering and rushes for the gap

SitOnNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to navigate to an object and sit on it for a specific duration of time

agent.description: Agent that will sit on the object

duration.description: The duration of time the agent will sit on the object

TalkToNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to talk to a target agent in a duration (second)

duration.description: The duration of time of the talk

WaveAtNodeSchema.Purpose: Command agent to wave at a target agent in a duration (second)

target_agent.description: The agent will be wave at

duration.description: The duration of time of the waving
